acceptance.given: A current-snapshot authority input names a Windows user-profile path as a runtime root.

oracle.expected: The current-snapshot resolver rejects the input before producing a current-authority snapshot.
forbidden: A user-profile path is accepted as a current-snapshot root or determines current authority.
oracle.observable: The snapshot-selector test receives a deterministic path-safety rejection and no authority snapshot is returned.

acceptance.then: User-profile paths cannot participate in current-authority selection.
acceptance.when: The toolchain determines current authority from declared snapshot roots.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise current_snapshot with a Windows user-profile path as a declared root and require rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject user-profile paths during current-snapshot root resolution so they cannot act as current authority.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Internal toolchain path-validation behavior only; current-snapshot schema and its eight root kinds remain unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: A user-profile root can be considered by snapshot selection -> user-profile root is rejected before authority resolution.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The snapshot exclusion selector proves that a Windows user-profile path cannot produce a current-authority snapshot.

acceptance.given: The evaluation aggregate is evaluated with its required stable-candidate matrix receipt absent.

oracle.expected: Aggregate validation reports missing matrix evidence, returns failure, and emits no implementation-complete authorization.
forbidden: The aggregate is valid, accepted, or authorizes implementation-complete while matrix evidence is missing.
oracle.observable: The RMAP-S2 validator result is nonzero with a missing matrix-evidence finding and no authorization.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is invalid and cannot be accepted.
acceptance.when: Required matrix evidence is missing during aggregate evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the RMAP-S2 aggregate validator against the existing evaluation artifact set with its required matrix receipt removed from the selector fixture.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make aggregate evaluation fail closed when the required stable-candidate matrix evidence is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The implementation-validation receipt schema remains compatible; only invalid aggregate inputs are rejected.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate evaluation with absent matrix evidence -> failed non-authorizing aggregate evaluation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate validator cannot return a passing or authorizing result without the required matrix evidence.

acceptance.given: The evaluation-seed manifest is evaluated as the record of the three named seed occurrences.

oracle.expected: Each named seed occurs exactly once and records provenance, applicability, missing labels, a counterexample or explicit absence, and approved non-baseline classification.
forbidden: A named evaluation seed occurs more or fewer than once.
A named evaluation seed occurrence lacks provenance, applicability, missing labels, counterexample-or-explicit-absence, or approved non-baseline classification.
oracle.observable: The RMAP-S2 validator accepts only a complete three-occurrence seed manifest and reports a deterministic finding for a missing required occurrence field.

acceptance.then: Every named evaluation seed occurrence has complete provenance-bearing metadata.
acceptance.when: A named evaluation seed occurrence is recorded and evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove provenance metadata from one named seed occurrence in the evaluation-seed manifest fixture and require RMAP-S2 validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate each of the three named evaluation-seed occurrences for exact uniqueness and all required provenance-bearing metadata.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The seed manifest remains non-authorizing and retains its existing schema version; validation adds required occurrence semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Seed occurrence with incomplete or unspecified provenance coverage -> exactly one fully classified, provenance-bearing occurrence for each named seed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: RMAP-S2 passes only when all three named seed occurrences are unique and complete, and fails when any occurrence lacks required provenance metadata.

acceptance.given: A fresh checkout contains only the recorded replay inputs and complete Current Snapshot binding.

oracle.expected: The repository-owned replay reconstructs the recorded result from the fresh checkout using the bound Current Snapshot.
forbidden: Replay depends on pre-existing local state or uncommitted workspace contents.
A fresh checkout produces a different result without an explicitly permitted change.
Unexplained result-determining input drift is accepted as reproducible.
oracle.observable: The replay selector succeeds from the fresh checkout and its receipt remains bound to the same complete Current Snapshot and recorded result.

acceptance.then: The recorded replay result is reproducible from a fresh checkout.
acceptance.when: Replay is executed from a fresh checkout.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the repository-owned replay selector from a fresh checkout fixture with a missing local-state dependency or result-determining snapshot drift and require a failed replay.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind repository-owned replay to a complete Current Snapshot and require the recorded result to reproduce from a fresh checkout; fail closed for local-state dependency or unexplained result-determining drift.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Replay receipts remain non-authorizing and retain existing historical portability semantics; invalid fresh-checkout or drifted inputs fail closed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay may depend on unstated workspace state -> replay reconstructs the bound Current Snapshot and reproduces the recorded result from a fresh checkout.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A fresh-checkout replay reproduces the recorded result with the same complete Current Snapshot; any local-state dependency or unexplained result-determining drift yields failure.
